transcript.content: Hello, and welcome. I'm Dr. [Name], a psychiatrist. Thank you for coming in today. What brings you to the clinic?

Well, Doctor, I came because... well, it's about the men down at the domino table. And sometimes the announcer on the radio, too. They keep giving these little messages that are meant just for me. My wife, she tells me it is just regular talk and I shouldn't pay it no mind, but... I know they are warning me to be careful. So that's why I'm here.

When you hear these messages from the men at the domino table or the radio announcer, do you actually hear their voices speaking directly to you, or do you understand the messages through the regular words they're saying?

Well, with the radio and the domino table, it's just the regular words they're saying. I just... I understand what they really mean by them. 

But I do hear actual voices sometimes, too. Some afternoons, when the house gets real quiet, I hear my old friend. I'll hear him call my name from the porch, or... or he'll be humming an old choir song. It sounds clear as a bell, just exactly like he is standing right there.
When you hear your old friend calling your name or humming from the porch, is anyone actually there on the porch, or do you hear the voice even though no one is physically present?

Well, that's the thing of it. There ain't nobody out there. I'll get up and look, thinking maybe he came by to visit, but the porch is empty. Still, I hear him clear as day, just calling my name or humming that choir tune, even though there's not a soul around.
How long have you been experiencing these voices and these special messages? Did they start suddenly, or did they come on gradually over time?
Well, they've been happening on and off for about... oh, I'd say about nine months now. It wasn't all at once, just kind of started up gradually over that time.

During these 9 months, have there been times when these voices and messages were happening almost every day for at least a couple of weeks in a row, or have they mostly come and gone with breaks in between?

Well, they've been pretty steady. I mean, there was about a month in there where things were quiet... well, quiet in my head, I guess. I was sleeping just fine, normal like, and I wasn't getting all worked up with those big plans I get sometimes. But even during that quiet month, I still heard my friend humming out on the porch, and I still knew that radio announcer was talking right to me. So they didn't really go away, even when the rest of me felt settled.

You mentioned you sometimes get big plans and feel worked up. During those times when you have these big plans, do you need less sleep than usual—like sleeping only a few hours but still feeling energetic and rested—and do these plans feel like really important ideas that you're confident will work out?

Yeah, that's pretty much it. When I get those ideas going, on those nights I may sleep only two or three hours. Then I just get up before daylight, and I'm feeling ready to work like I had a full rest. I don't feel tired at all, and I feel real sure that my plans are gonna work out just fine, so I just want to get right to it.

When you first started hearing your friend's voice on the porch and understanding those special messages from the radio and domino table—did that happen before you noticed the times when you only needed a few hours of sleep and had those big plans, or did the voices and messages start after you were already having those periods of big plans and high energy?

Well, let me think on that. They kind of started up before the big plans and the energy. I remember hearing my friend out on the porch and getting those messages first. But the thing is, even when I get into those bright, restless weeks where I'm barely sleeping and I'm full of those big ideas... the voices don't stop. I still hear my friend humming out there, and I still feel like the men at the domino table or the radio are sending me warnings. It all just keeps going, even when I'm all worked up.

When you first started hearing your friend's voice on the porch, back at the very beginning nine months ago, were you also in one of those periods where you were sleeping just a few hours, feeling full of energy and big plans? Or did the voices start when you were feeling more like your normal self?

Well, actually... those times when I'm all worked up with the big plans and only sleeping a couple hours, those started before the voices. I've been having those weeks of high energy and big ideas coming back on me for about 11 months now. So I was already having those spells before I started hearing my friend on the porch nine months ago.

During that quiet month you mentioned—when you were sleeping normally and didn't have those big plans—did the voices from your friend and the messages from the radio and domino table completely stop during that time, or did they keep happening even when you felt settled?

Well, no, they didn't stop. Even during that quiet month when I was getting my regular sleep and wasn't all fired up with those plans... I still heard him. My friend was still out there on the porch, and I still knew the radio was sending those messages to me. So, yeah, that kept right on going even when I felt settled down.

When you think back to those first weeks and months when the voices and messages started—before you had been having those high-energy weeks with big plans—did you notice anything else going on with your mood? Were you feeling sad, depressed, or down during that time, or were you feeling pretty normal otherwise?

I don't really remember feeling sad or down back then. I mean, I wasn't depressed or anything like that. Besides hearing my friend and getting those messages, I was feeling pretty normal, I guess. My mood was just... regular.

You mentioned those high-energy weeks with big plans started about 11 months ago, before the voices came. During those first weeks of high energy and big plans, back 11 months ago, were you sleeping very little but still feeling full of energy and confidence—was that a normal kind of busy feeling, or did it feel different, like your mood was unusually elevated or expansive?

Well, it definitely felt different than just being normally busy. During those times... I mean, I'd wake up feeling just so bright and important. I'd be laughing out loud, talking real fast about everything I was going to do. It felt like I was on top of the world. But... well, if somebody tried to slow me down or questioned my plans, I'd get pretty sharp with them. I'd snap right back. So yeah, it was unusually high, but also kind of touchy if things didn't go my way.

Going back to those first few months when you started hearing your friend's voice and getting those messages from the radio—during all that time, were you having those high-energy weeks with big plans the whole time, or were there stretches of weeks or more when you were feeling your normal self, not all worked up, but you were still hearing the voice and getting those messages?

Well, let me think on that... I don't rightly know if I can remember exactly how those first few months went. The days kind of run together when I look back that far. 

I mean, I know I had that quiet month I told you about, where I wasn't all worked up but I was still hearing him. But right at the very start of it all... I'm just not sure if I was full of energy that whole entire time, or if I had normal weeks mixed in there too. I just don't remember it clear enough to say for sure.

I know it's hard to remember exactly, but let me ask this a different way: When you very first started hearing your friend's voice on the porch—that very first time it happened nine months ago—were you in one of those high-energy weeks where you were barely sleeping and full of big plans, or were you feeling and functioning pretty normally at that moment?

Well... thinking back to that very first time on the porch, I was definitely in one of those bright, restless weeks. I was hardly sleeping at all, just making all sorts of big plans. 

But you know, even when I get like that—all worked up and busy—I still hear my friend's voice. It doesn't go away. I still feel like the radio or those domino men are sending me warnings, even during those high-energy times when I'm barely sleeping. So, yes sir, I was already having one of those spells when he first spoke to me.

So, yes sir, I was already having one of those spells when he first spoke to me.

inference.note: Ruled out F20.0 (Schizophrenia). The patient's psychotic symptoms (hallucinations and delusions) began during a manic/hypomanic episode 11 months ago, and the hallucinations persist even during euthymic periods. This pattern—psychotic symptoms emerging in the context of mood episodes and continuing across mood states—is characteristic of Schizoaffective Disorder, Bipolar Type (F25.0) rather than Schizophrenia. In schizophrenia, psychotic symptoms typically precede or occur independently of mood disturbances.
